EDDA MARÉN TO TESS ROWAN. September 25, 1840
Dear colleague,
On September 22, 1840, Edda Marén sent the coastal dispatch. This record was written on September 25, 1840.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
